episodes.title: Awakening to the Joy of Painting
episodes.summary: Life and priorities change for listless high schooler Yatora when he sees his classmate's painting and discovers an appreciation and talent for art.
episodes.imageAlt: Awakening to the Joy of Painting

episodes.title: He's Not Tanned at All
episodes.summary: Yatora enters the art club. Over summer break he takes part in special training to improve his skills after switching his college choice to art school.
episodes.imageAlt: Prep School Debut of the Dead

episodes.title: Prep School Debut of the Dead
episodes.summary: Yatora joins Yuka for extra lessons at Tokyo Art Institute. He has an artistic breakthrough when visiting a museum with his strange new classmates.

episodes.title: Where Are We Headed?
episodes.summary: TAI's night students join the intimidating afternoon classes to gear up for the next competition as the stress of art exams weigh on Yatora's friends.
episodes.imageAlt: Helpless Even If I Know What To Do

episodes.title: Helpless Even If I Know What to Do
episodes.summary: As exams near, Oba intensifies training. Yatora struggles to articulate abstract concepts, so Saeki encourages him to use a larger canvas for fun.

episodes.title: Serious Mental Breakdown
episodes.summary: Yatora experiments with various tools to find a secret weapon that will boost his art while exam stress begins to wear on the students' health.
episodes.imageAlt: The Start of the First Exam

episodes.title: The Start of the First Exam
episodes.summary: Oba tells Yatora his weakness, which sends him spiraling. But a heart-to-heart with a close friend reignites his confidence as the first exam begins!

episodes.title: Brain-Racking
episodes.summary: The first exam subject is "self-portrait." A mishap gives Yatora the hint he needs; Oba takes the class to a museum before exam results are announced.

episodes.title: Wandering Knife
episodes.summary: Three move on to the second exam, including Yatora, who must master "color." Yatora worries after Yuka gets a seedy job and refuses to go to art school.

episodes.title: Our Color Blue
episodes.summary: Yuka and Yatora head to Odawara and bare their souls and bodies, hoping to overcome their personal challenges with art and their surrounding fears.
episodes.imageAlt: The Start of the Second Exam

episodes.title: The Start of the Second Exam
episodes.summary: After drawing his own body, Yatora is ready for the second exam: a nude model. But when his health declines from stress, Oba offers a secret weapon.
episodes.imageAlt: When I Started to be Dyed in Color

episodes.title: When I Started to Be Dyed in Color
episodes.summary: The second exam is in full swing. Yatora struggles with illness and an unclear theme when sudden inspiration delivers answers and a final secret weapon.
